newsitem.title: INDIA: India stocks end higher, blue chips notch gains.
newsitem.headline: India stocks end higher, blue chips notch gains.

text.p: ** (1230 GMT) - Shares at India bourses close higher
** Bombay's top-30 index gains 29.34 points, or 0.84
** National exchange index climbs 7.30 pts to 1,009.45
** Major players quiet, await market trend amid poor
** Foreign funds still buyers in select pivotals
** Delhi share index up 5.20 pts to 751.55, Calcutta
3.41 pts to 454.96 and Madras 21.40 pts to 3,384.89
